description: This file defines a class `SSOOIDCClient` for interacting with the AWS SSO OIDC service. It extends the `AwsClient` and declares methods related to OAuth token creation and device authorization, including both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: SSOOIDCClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the AWS SSO OIDC service, extending AwsClient and providing methods for token management and device authorization.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates an OAuth token using provided arguments.

methods.name: createTokenWithIAM
methods.description: Creates an OAuth token using IAM credentials.

methods.name: createTokenWithIAMAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an OAuth token with IAM credentials.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client with the SSO OIDC service.

methods.name: registerClientAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers a client with the SSO OIDC service.

methods.name: startDeviceAuthorizationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the device authorization process.
